thread:
anya: Heads up — deploying the Next Edge sample with SDK v0.9.2 caused a middleware crash: "TypeError: Failed to construct 'Request': body used" when SDK retried.

kevin: That matches the 'stream locked on edge' problem. Are you on ESM build?

anya: Yes, ESM. Minimal repro:

anya: ```js
export const config = { runtime: 'edge' }
export default async function middleware(req) {
  await Redwood.generate({ input: req })
}
```

kevin: SDK retry tries to re-send the same Request body, which isn't clonable in Edge. Workarounds: 1) disable retries in middleware, 2) buffer req.text() then pass the string, or 3) use a bodyFactory option (preferred).

fiona: We added bodyFactory in the branch fix/edge-body-factory. API: Redwood.generate(payload, { bodyFactory?: () => BodyInit, retryOptions?: { attempts: number } }).

ci-bot: CI: started tests for fix/edge-body-factory (lint, unit, e2e-edge)

kevin: Typing note: expand types to accept ReadableStream | BodyInit | (() => BodyInit) so TS in Next middleware accepts it. Add small helper `bodyFactoryFromRequest(req, maxBytes)` to buffer safely.

anya: Docs request: please show minimal buffer example and a no-retry example. Also troubleshooting note: look for 'body used' or 'Cannot clone a locked stream'.

fiona: I'll update docs and add an example in examples/next-edge. Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/245

ci-bot: CI: e2e-edge job flaky on windows matrix, rerun requested by ci-bot

kevin: Thanks — we'll test on staging. If buffering is too heavy for some customers we can default to bodyFactory opt-in via an env flag.

anya: Great, thanks — saved our deploy.
